title: A Live-Action Anime Adaptation is Tearing Up The Box Office Charts
content: One Piece, Avatar: The Last Airbender, and Yu Yu Hakusho are just three examples of live-action anime adaptations that have been a success. While the stories of Yusuke Urameshi and Aang might be less critically well-received than Luffy’s outing, all three live-action series have new seasons in the works.
author: ComicBook

title: Exclusive: Nakama Press to Release Ace of the Diamond Baseball Manga in Omnibus Volumes
content: Mad Cave Studios' Nakama Press imprint confirmed to ANN on Friday that it will release the Yūji Terajima 's Ace of the Diamond baseball manga in a 3-in-1 omnibus format, starting with the first omnibus volume on March 23, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Netflix’s The One Piece Just Debunked Its Biggest Theory
content: Netflix’s The One Piece anime adaptation is set to become the next major installment in the franchise, and the latest news debunking one popular theory makes the project even more exciting.
author: ComicBook

title: After 20 Year Wait, Simpsons Movie Sequel May Have Just Revealed Perfect Title
content: Shockingly enough, it has almost been twenty years since we last saw the likes of Homer, Marge, Bart, Lisa, and Maggie in their own cinematic outing. The Simpsons Movie hit theaters in 2007, giving the Springfield residents an adventure that was simply too big for the small screen.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Brings Back Cult-Favorite Anime Following Removal
content: While the streaming world offers subscribers the opportunity to check out countless television shows and movies, many fans have witnessed a worrying trend across various platforms.

title: 'Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Kesshou Member Ketteisen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
content: The official website for the Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Kesshou Member Ketteisen television anime series revealed additional cast, new staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Friday. The sequel anime is scheduled to premiere on October 1 at 12.00 a.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The End of Oak Street Reveals Surprise Anime Crossover For Opening Weekend
content: While films like Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey are still tearing up the box office charts, this doesn’t mean that other movies aren’t attempting to carve a path of their own in theaters this weekend.
author: ComicBook

title: Disney+ Announces Cast for Live-Action Webtoon-Based Series A Man's Man
content: Disney+ unveiled the cast lineup on July 28 for A Man's Man , the live-action series based on the webtoon of the same name. Jeong-min Park will star as Yoo-hyun Han, with Sung-woo Bae, Ji-hyun Kim, Moon-sung Jung, Sang-hoon Moon, and Min Kim playing members of his product planning team.
author: ANN

title: Naver WEBTOON Cooperates With Korea's MCST, Interpol to Take Down 3 English Webtoon, Manga Piracy Sites
content: Naver WEBTOON announced on August 13 that three major English-language websites illegally distributing webtoons and manga have been taken down through cooperation with South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism; INTERPOL; and law enforcement authorities in North Africa.
author: ANN
